text:
“Thank you for your service” should be said often every day to our nation’s heroes, especially on Veterans Day. We owe our veterans more than words of gratitude. We must deliver the benefits and support they need after their service, through bills like my Veterans Housing Opportunity Act, which ensures veterans can access the high-quality benefits they’ve earned.

Today, I spoke on the House floor to recognize all our veterans for their service to our country, including men like retired Lackawanna County Judge and Vietnam Veteran Tom Munley.

This American hero showed courage on the battlefield and here at home and, incidentally, was recognized last week as the 2026 Tribute to Courage honoree at the Spirit of Hope Awards. 

As Tom makes clear on his Veterans View segment on WBRE, fighting for those who have given so much to defend our country is a tremendous responsibility, and I urge my colleagues to continue the fight to ensure we live up to the promise made to all those who have served.
